understanding.goal_understanding: Complete each level by activating all goal cells. A goal cell is completed when you step onto it while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes. Finishing all goals advances to the next level; winning all levels completes the game. Avoid running out of lives.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (north/south/east/west) and spend stamina; movement can be blocked by walls, which prevents position change but still consumes stamina. If stamina reaches 0, you lose a life and stamina resets. Your carried piece has three attributes—shape, color, and rotation—which can be changed by stepping on modifier tiles: shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. To complete a goal, adjust your piece using these modifiers until all three attributes match the goal, then step onto the goal cell.
